what: CL.TE request smuggling against a deliberately lenient HTTP/1.1 backend, direct versus through the gateway
why_deterministic: The effect is a parser disagreement, not a race: the same bytes always produce the same two-request interpretation at a Content-Length-first backend.
fixture_caveat: The backend (lab/smuggle/raw_backend.py) is lenient by design - Content-Length wins over Transfer-Encoding - because that disagreement is what smuggling is. It is a measurement instrument, not a claim about any product.

through_gateway.forwarded_bytes: no Content-Length, no Transfer-Encoding, no body: the gateway consumed the framing itself and reframed the request

note: Stripping hop-by-hop headers (transfer-encoding, te) and re-framing the body are what close this class. A gateway that forwarded the client's framing verbatim would reproduce the desync.
